entries.5a7de35837110794: This business provides security, cleaning, office services and facility management as an integrated package for various buildings, such as government and corporate office buildings, stores, hotels and hospitals. There are annual contracts, under which services are provided continuously over a set period, and temporary contracts, under which services are provided only at specific times. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,569.11 million. The company and its consolidated subsidiaries RSC Chubu Co., Ltd., Cleanforce Co., Ltd. and RSC Security Co., Ltd. handle security and cleaning, and Yuwa Shoko Co., Ltd. handles interior finishing work.
entries.6b3058d66e06a009: This division provides daily and periodic building cleaning, as well as temporary cleaning such as additional and special cleaning, and patrol cleaning. Revenue is not separately disclosed.
